prerequisites: Basic knowledge of planar and spacial geometry

learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to identify, formulate and develop the documentation of a simple design or technological task, including the description of the results of this task in Polish or in a foreign language and to present the results using computer software or other aiding tools. The student can present elements on the basis of the parallel projection. The student writes and read the shape of the mechanical construction. Can define the state of the surface, dimensions the machine elements and creates working drawing based on the norms of the technical drawing.

syllabus_topics: The role of the engineering drawing in the industry
Introduction to preparation of the technical objects
Projections of: points, lines, planes, solids
Presentation of solids cut by multiple planes
Views and sections of machine elements
Position of the element on the drawing
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for both the final test and class projects is 60%. The final grade is composed of 60% from the final test and 40% from class projects.
